acceptanceQuestion: Could these views plausibly be photographs/technical representations of the exact same physical set?

source.description: Korri's Coffee House photo: leather sofa left, long dark bar center, tables right, EXIT/windows left, brick and COFFEE FOCUS CREATE right.

atlas.description: Top-down multi-room light-wood floor plan. Not the same physical café as the source photo.

productErs.description: Abstract dark void with neon yellow scribbles. Not a café. Not an ERS sheet.

nativeSmoke.result: near-black; short preserve-cafe prompt did not recover the set

rootCause: Whole-sheet 9-panel ERS prompt at 2560x1440 with EmptyLatentImage denoise 1.0 does not preserve Schnick geometry. Atlas is a different building than the source photo. Visual Canon was unavailable so canon injection could not constrain architecture. Bounded graph tweaks (steps/cfg, CLIPTextEncode negative) did not produce the café; CLIPTextEncode negative made output black and was reverted. Per-panel ERS v2 was not created.
